impact: Hit 1,500 organizations and breached systems of roughly 60 of Kaseya’s direct customers.
Stole information related to Morgan Stanley stock plan participants.
Kept the district offline for more than a week, leaving them unable to pay welfare benefits.
Stolen personal information of over 75,000 individuals and encrypted over 15,000 devices.
Targeted engineers from Europe and the US.
mitigation_measures: Check Point Harmony Endpoint provides protection against this threat.
Check Point Anti-Bot provides protection against this threat.
Check Point Threat Emulation and Threat Extraction provide protection against this threat.
Check Point IPS and Harmony Endpoint provide protection against this threat.
Check Point Anti-Virus and Anti-Bot provide protection against this threat.
